explain.ja: elmo囲いは図1-1のような陣形で、対振り急戦に使われる囲いです。金を▲7九金と寄るのが特徴で、舟囲いより堅く、振り飛車相手に強く戦えます。四間飛車や三間飛車といった振り飛車と戦うときに使います。
explain.en: The elmo castle has the shape of Figure 1-1 and is used for fast attacks against Ranging Rook. Its feature is moving the gold to 7九; it is firmer than Funagakoi and fights strongly against Ranging Rook. It is used against Fourth File Rook, Third File Rook and the like.

section.ja: エルモ囲いってどんな囲い?
section.en: What kind of castle is the Elmo castle?

title.ja: 図2-1 対振り飛車の基本形
title.en: Figure 2-1: Basic form against Ranging Rook

explain.ja: 図2-1は対振り飛車の基本形で、相手は四間飛車に組んでいます。この形からelmo囲いに組む手順を見ます。
explain.en: Figure 2-1 is the basic form against Ranging Rook, with the opponent playing Fourth File Rook. We see how to build the elmo castle from this shape.

title.ja: 図2-2 持久戦風の出だし

explain.ja: 図2-1から▲5八金右とすれば舟囲いの形になりますが、今回はelmo囲いを目指すので金上がりを省略し、▲5七銀と右銀を5筋に上げておきます。この形からelmo囲いではなく居飛車穴熊のような持久戦に組む順も有力です。
explain.en: From Figure 2-1, ▲5八金右 would give Funagakoi, but to aim for elmo here the gold move is skipped and the right silver is raised to ▲5七銀. From this shape, building a long-game setup like Static Rook Anaguma instead of elmo is also strong.

section.ja: 持久戦風の出だしだが...
section.en: It looks like a long game opening, but...

explain.ja: 図2-2からは駒組みが進みます。▲6八銀上から▲7九金とするのがelmo囲いの形です。対振り急戦で使われ、舟囲いより堅いので強く戦えます。
explain.en: From Figure 2-2 the setup proceeds. ▲6八銀上 then ▲7九金 forms the elmo castle. Used in fast attacks against Ranging Rook, it is firmer than Funagakoi so you can fight strongly.

section.ja: ▲7九金と寄って、エルモ囲い急戦に!
section.en: Shift with ▲7九金 into a Elmo castle rapid attack!

line.text: △7二玉、▲2五歩、△8二玉、▲3六歩、△7二銀、▲6八銀上、△9四歩、▲9六歩、△4三銀、▲7九金

title.ja: 図2-4 ▲5九金でさらに堅くなる
title.en: Figure 2-4: ▲5九金 makes it even firmer

explain.ja: 右の金を▲5九金と寄ると、囲いがさらに堅くなります。elmo囲い急戦では5七の銀を攻めに使うのが基本なので、金2枚と銀1枚で囲っていることになります。右金を4九に置いたまま素早く仕掛けることもあります。
explain.en: Moving the right gold to ▲5九金 makes the castle firmer. In the elmo fast attack the silver on 5七 is basically used for attack, so the castle uses two golds and one silver. Sometimes the right gold stays on 4九 and the attack is launched quickly.

title.en: Figure 3-1: Elmo castle + diagonal Climbing Silver

explain.ja: ここからelmo囲い急戦の仕掛けのパターンをいくつか見ます。図2-4から▲4六銀から▲3五歩と斜め棒銀で仕掛けるのが基本の攻め筋です。
explain.en: Now several attacking patterns of the elmo fast attack. From Figure 2-4 the basic attack is the diagonal Climbing Silver, ▲4六銀 then ▲3五歩.

title.ja: 図3-2 一気に捌き合いに
title.en: Figure 3-2: Straight into an exchange fight

explain.ja: ▲3五歩に対して△同歩、▲同銀と進むと、斜め棒銀の攻めが決まります。相手は△3二飛と飛車を3筋に回して捌きを狙うのが定跡です。図3-2の局面からは、飛車角を捌き合って一気に終盤戦に突入します。
explain.en: Against ▲3五歩, if play goes △同歩, ▲同銀, the diagonal Climbing Silver attack succeeds. The joseki for the opponent is to swing the rook to the 3rd file with △3二飛 aiming at sabaki. From Figure 3-2 rooks and bishops are traded and the game enters the endgame at once.

title.ja: 図3-3 elmo囲い+4五歩早仕掛け
title.en: Figure 3-3: Elmo castle + 4五歩 early attack

explain.ja: elmo囲いと4五歩早仕掛けを組み合わせる形も有力です。図2-4から▲4六歩、▲4五歩と仕掛けます。これに△同歩なら、角交換してから▲2四歩と2筋を攻められます。
explain.en: Combining the elmo castle with the early ▲4五歩 attack is also strong. From Figure 2-4 attack with ▲4六歩 and ▲4五歩. If White takes with △同歩, exchange bishops and then attack the 2nd file with ▲2四歩.

title.ja: 図3-4 桂跳ねで力を溜める
title.en: Figure 3-4: Build strength with a knight jump

explain.ja: 相手は▲4五歩に△同歩と取れないので、無視して駒組みを進めます。こちらもすぐには▲4四歩と取り込まず、桂馬を跳ねて力を溜めておきます。
explain.en: The opponent cannot take ▲4五歩 with △同歩, so it ignores it and continues its setup. Black also does not immediately capture ▲4四歩, but jumps the knight to build up strength.

title.ja: 図3-5 △同銀にさらに▲4五歩を狙う
title.en: Figure 3-5: Aim for another ▲4五歩 after △同銀

explain.ja: 4筋の歩を取り込む前に、2筋を突き捨ててから仕掛けます。ここから△同銀にさらに▲4五歩と打ち、角交換を狙うのが定跡です。
explain.en: Before taking in the 4th-file pawn, sacrifice a pawn on the 2nd file and then attack. From here, against △同銀 drop ▲4五歩 again, aiming for a bishop exchange; this is joseki.

title.ja: 図3-6 elmo囲い+右四間飛車
title.en: Figure 3-6: Elmo castle + Fourth File Rook on the right

explain.ja: elmo囲いは右四間飛車と組み合わせる形もあります。攻めの狙いが分かりやすく強力なので、特に級位者にはおすすめです。
explain.en: The elmo castle can also be combined with Right Fourth File Rook. The aim of the attack is easy to understand and strong, so it is recommended especially for kyu players.

title.en: Figure 3-7: ▲2五桂 to ▲4五歩 is the basic plan

explain.ja: ▲2五桂として相手の角に働きかけてから▲4五歩と仕掛けるのが、右四間飛車の基本の狙い筋です。このあとは、▲1一角成と馬を作る手や、銀交換して▲3三銀と打ち込む攻めがあります。
explain.en: The basic aim of Right Fourth File Rook is to pressure the opponent's bishop with ▲2五桂 and then attack with ▲4五歩. After that there are attacks such as making a horse with ▲1一角成, or exchanging silvers and dropping ▲3三銀.
